units.source_text: “这类问题，你最好去请教歌德。

en.t: For questions like this, you had better go ask Goethe.

units.source_text: 因为那小子既是生物学者又是诗人。

en.t: After all, that fellow is both a biologist and a poet.

units.source_text: 总而言之，希望你不要随便把我的研究写入女子的诗歌里。”

en.t: In short, I hope you will not casually write my research into women's poetry.
